verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships its own versioned Data Access API. The SwaggerHub OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec is published under a version-2 path, and the developer portal lists a dedicated "Versioning" page (docs/data-access-versioning). The pack does not show that page's contents, and nothing documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guarantees, so this half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, the actual contents of the versioning page (version selection mechanism and support windows), and independent corroboration of version stability.
